prices.component_assumption: Apply aggregate CPI-U growth uniformly to all future CE price components; not CBO component forecasts
prices.formula: CBO_level[y]/CBO_level[y-1]-1; future growth applied to observed BLS2025 anchor
prices.rent_assumption: Baseline nominal rent growth equals this CPI-U path; same path deflates future rent cohorts; not CBO local rent forecasts

sources.derivation_method: Match Census2020 county codes to February2013 metropolitan CBSA county delineations; recognized published2024 SPM MSA codes use fullMSA approximation, other metropolitan counties use the same-state residualMetro only when published, remaining counties use published same-stateNonmetro. Unrepresented counties retain null area. Join county assignments to population-weighted PUMA/county fractions, aggregate once per PUMA/area and preserve unassigned fractions. The exact resulting final allocation map is committed in area_allocations; suppressed/unsampled CPS state portions remain unresolved.

Sum Census2020 P.L.94-171 geographic header summary-level140 POP100 by PUMA and county using Census2020 tract-to-PUMA relationship. Validate each state total against summary-level040. Divide each PUMA/county population by its PUMA total. The exact resulting final PUMA-to-area allocation map is committed in area_allocations.
